title: A Modular Agentic Framework for Synthetically Constrained Multi-Objective Hit-to-Lead Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.11483v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hit-to-lead optimization requires iterative design of hit analogs across competing potency, selectivity, physicochemical, pharmacokinetic, safety, and synthetic constraints. We present SABLE (Synthetically-accessible Agentic Bayesian Ligand Exploration), an open-source framework that employs natural-language orchestration to guide chemical structure optimization. SABLE uses an LLM to interpret user-defined goals and route tasks, while specialized tools perform reaction-templated analog enumeration, physicochemical and ADMET property prediction, structure-based affinity scoring, and Bayesian optimization. The resulting workflow is a computational twin of the analytical and prioritization stages of the design-make-test-analyze cycle, providing provenance of each numerical output. translated_title: 一种用于合成约束多目标先导物优化的模块化智能体框架
translated_abstract: 先导物优化需要在竞争性的效能、选择性、理化性质、药代动力学、安全性和合成约束之间进行迭代设计。我们提出了SABLE（合成可及性智能体贝叶斯配体探索），这是一个开源框架，采用自然语言编排来指导化学结构优化。SABLE使用大语言模型（LLM）来解读用户定义的目标并路由任务，同时专用工具执行反应模板化的类似物枚举、理化性质和ADMET（吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性）属性预测、基于结构的亲和力评分以及贝叶斯优化。由此产生的工作流是设计-制造-测试-分析循环中分析和优先级排序阶段的计算孪生体，为每个数值输出提供可追溯性。在单目标和多目标优化研究中，SABLE在仅评估子集的情况下，丰富了用户定义计算目标的候选集。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型驱动的模块化智能体框架SABLE，通过自然语言编排和贝叶斯优化，在合成约束下高效实现多目标先导物优化，并确保每个结果的完整可追溯性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents SABLE, an LLM-driven modular agentic framework that uses natural-language orchestration and Bayesian optimization to efficiently perform multi-objective hit-to-lead optimization under synthetic constraints, with full provenance for each output.
